But could taking supplements than the body needs actually do more harm than good?(Author: Dr. Asma Pathan- Cancer Physician, M|O|C Cancer Care Pune)The answer is more complicated than a simple yes or no. In circumstances research has even linked specific supplements to an increased risk of cancer.
